case_title: YEFIM LYAMES VS. CHAE SUN PECK

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $7,500.00 FILED BY LYAMES, YEFIM AS TO DEFENDANT PECK, CHAE SUN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-10-2016 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - FEE FOR SERVICE $35.00 - SERVED MAY-15-2016, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT PECK, CHAE SUN
STIPULATION FOR HEARING BEFORE PRO TEM JUDGE DAVID LAVINE. FILED BY LYAMES, YEFIM PECK, CHAE SUN

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUN-10-2016 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUN-10-2016 BY JUDGE PRO TEM DAVID LAVINE. PLAINTIFF WAS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF WAS ASSISTED BY RUSSIAN INTERPRETER---OLIM ALIZHANOV. PLAINTIFFS EXHIBITS RETAINED. DEFENDANTS EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: DAVID LAVINE. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-10-2016 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LYAMES, YEFIM RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT PECK, CHAE SUN $3,039.00 PRINCIPAL, $110.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $3,149.00, ON BALANCE, THE EVIDENCE SUPPORTS THE PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM MORE THAN DEFENDANT'S VERSION. DAMAGES FOR MEDICAL AND PHYSCIAL THERAPY BILLS ARE AWARDED TO PLAINTIFF. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT PECK, CHAE SUN
